name: Nyota
tagline: AI meeting notetaker that syncs to your project tools and CRM.
description: An AI meeting assistant that joins Zoom, Google Meet, and Microsoft Teams to transcribe and summarize calls, then pushes action items into project management tools and CRMs like Jira, Asana, ClickUp, HubSpot, and Salesforce. Also prepares agendas and tracks follow-ups across recurring meetings.
edge: Leans into project/people management — auto-creating tickets and tracking action items in PM tools — rather than just producing a transcript.
pros: Syncs to Jira, Asana, HubSpot, Salesforce
Joins Zoom, Google Meet, and Teams
cons: Joins calls as a bot participant
